task_contract.possession: ball-to-player-footpoint distance < 1.5 m for >= 3 consecutive frames
task_contract.possession_transition: every stable A-to-B possession change within the transfer gap, including opponents and short/ID-jitter candidates
task_contract.pass_network: same-team stable A-to-B transfer with metric displacement >= 0.5 m; tactical-intent proxy, human review required
task_contract.acceptance: deterministic time-spread sample of 20; human agreement >= 80%

warnings: global_id remains a run-local candidate identity; ID switches directly affect the pass matrix.
K-means team numbers are cluster labels, not semantic home/away names.
Possession transitions and pass-network edges are separate outputs; turnovers and ID jitter never enter the pass matrix.
The 0.25-0.5m same-team gray zone is exported only for human review and never counted in the formal pass network.
Tactical intent is represented only by an auditable same-team+stable-control+metric-displacement proxy, not claimed as ground truth.
